documents.text: Toronto security. method. Hide your weapon in the wall cabinet before security, hiding the Pistol before Toronto security, Pistol storage before security, service level wall cabinet. After looting the COM room, hide the Pistol + Canisters in the wall cabinet on the service level before passing security.

COM access. method. Use code 1042 to access the COM room, COM room access code, COM service level access ladder. Talk to Joe, then use the access ladder in the room north of Joe’s; key in 1042 to enter the COM/service level access.

Pistol. method. Get the Pistol from the COM room (cannot be sold; critical later), Pistol damaged console, Pistol and Canisters acquisition. In the COM room, examine the damaged console to get the Pistol + Canisters; grab the extra Stimdrinks from the east drawer.

Anne. method. Talk to Anne 6 times for free rations, Anne free chocolate and rations. In the mess hall, talk to Anne at the counter, take the free chocolate, end talk, repeat 6 times for extra rations.

Inspector Beegle’s room supplies. method. Search Inspector Beegle’s room for supplies, Inspector Beegle supplies, Beegle room supplies, Beegle north cabinet contents, Beegle left cupboard contents. Inspector Beegle’s room: search the left cupboard (rations) and the north cabinet (canisters).
Drirr. method. Recruit Drirr in Jirinaar. After the festival murder sequence in Jirinaar, Drirr joins automatically as part of the investigation.
Sira. method. Recruit Sira after confronting Bradir. Confront Bradir in the Dji-Fadh guild (north wing) and complete that sequence; Sira joins after the story scene.
Rejira. method. Optional: Rejira exploit — farm Blue Healing Potions for money, Rejira potion money method. Rejira can repeatedly provide Blue Healing Potions; sell to Rabir for steady early money.

Former’s Building. method. Former’s Building stat bonuses: Speed +10, Stamina +10, Strength +10, Former's Building stat boost route, rainbow bushes and hidden cracked-wall passages. Former’s Building: use the rainbow bushes / hidden cracked-wall passages for party-wide stat boosts (+10 Speed/Stamina/Strength).

Jirinaar training. method. Optional: Train in Jirinaar (2.5G per point; cheapest in the game), Jirinaar skill training costs, cheapest training prices. Jirinaar has the cheapest training (2.5G per point). Train key skills here before leaving the island.
Melthas. method. Recruit Melthas at the Druid’s hut. Reach the Druid’s hut (Arjano area) after Klouta/Vanello; the scene inside recruits Melthas.
Monster Eye. method. Buy the Monster Eye (450G) — essential, Monster Eye purchase from Rifrako. Buy the Monster Eye from Rifrako (mixed goods) — it’s a key utility item and hard to replace.
Dreamshield. method. Consider Dreamshield from Aballon (very strong value), Dreamshield purchase from Rifrako. Rifrako in Aballon sells Dreamshield (strong value shield) and other essentials.

Mountain pass bandits. method. Optional: Farm bandits in the mountain pass for money, mountain pass loot selling, bandit loot Winion prices. Mountain pass ambushes are a reliable early money source; sell loot at Winion (Vanello) for best local prices.

Beloveno recruitment. method. Choose Siobhan or Khunag (initially mutually exclusive), Choose Siobhan or Khunag, Beloveno companion choice, Siobhan or Khunag recruitment choice. Beloveno: you can recruit Siobhan directly, or recruit Khunag via dialogue (he’s required later for Kenget Kamulos).

Herras assassination. method. Complete the assassination prevention sequence (timed event). Timed sequence: talk to Herras (council), visit Kariah (ask “Yes” + “Information”), find Melthas’s friend (Kounos), buy Edjiir info (Srimalinar), return to Herras (ask “Assassination”), then find Melthas’s friend again to trigger the event.

Herras’s Key. method. Get Herras’s Key (treasury access), Herras reward key, treasury key reward conditions. After saving Herras, ask him about reward to receive Herras’s Key; the treasury chest contains major loot.
Harriet. method. Recruit Harriet (replaces Rainer), Harriet Goddess cave fast travel. Harriet joins on Dji-Cantos and replaces Rainer; she is essential for Goddess cave fast travel.

Goddess’s Flowers. method. Find all 8 Goddess’s Flowers (permanent +3 stat boosts; recharge over time), Goddess flower stat bonus and recharge. Use the chapter’s flower locations list; there are 8 total and each boosts a stat by +3 when used (recharges over time).

Umajo trade. method. Use Umajo shops (130% sell — best in the game), valuable loot selling, high value loot selling in Umajo. Umajo has the best sell rates in the game (130%). Hoard high-value loot until you reach Umajo.
Porenoil. method. Get Porenoil for desert survival, Porenoil dehydration protection. Ask Merdger/Merger in the Equipment Maker’s Guild about Porenoil; it prevents dehydration in the desert.

Toronto route. method. Find the path forward (Ohl can guide for a Jewel), Umajo to Toronto route, Toronto cave entrance directions, Ohl guide payment. To reach Toronto: either pay Ohl a Jewel (meet via the Miner’s Guild schedule) or follow the “stones to coastline then south” route to the cave entrance.

Toronto return codes. method. Use ship codes: 1001, 1712, 4312, Toronto reactor codes, Toronto return code sequence, notebook code 1001, reversed code-notes 4312. Toronto Again: use 1001 (notebook), then 1712 (service level), then 4312 (code-notes reversed) to reach the reactor sequence.

Toronto evidence. method. Collect evidence and return to Dji-Cantos, Toronto evidence footage delivery, Toronto evidence return destination. After the reactor scene, return to Dji-Cantos with the evidence/video footage for the payout and to progress toward the finale.

Kenget Kamulos entry. prerequisites. Bring Khunag (required to enter Kenget Kamulos), Kenget Kamulos entrance requirement, Khunag active party entry gate. Hard gate: you cannot enter Kenget Kamulos without Khunag in the party.

Kamulos. method. Defeat Kamulos and obtain the High Knowledge, Kamulos Frost immunity and Thorn Snare. Kamulos is immune to Frost; use Thorn Snare to lock him down, then focus damage to secure the High Knowledge.

Bolt-Throwers. method. Optional: Before surrendering, repeat the guard battle for Bolt-Throwers, Bolt-Thrower farming, farm Bolt-Throwers, Bolt-Thrower sale profit. Optional money: the surrender/loop fights can be farmed for Bolt-Throwers; sell in Umajo for massive profit.

Umajo Danu. method. Learn the secret word: “Umajo Danu”, Equipment Makers secret word, mine shaft ceremony infiltration. Secret word: infiltrate the mine shaft ceremony without being seen to hear “Umajo Danu”.
Metalmagic Scroll. method. Obtain the Metalmagic Scroll, Metalmagic Scroll secret word exchange. Find Kossotto and speak the secret word to receive the Metalmagic Scroll.

Blue floor plate. method. Optional: Blue floor plate summons 16 Animal 3s (5760 XP), blue floor plate tactics, blue floor plate use, blue plate back row and Demon Exodus. Optional XP: the blue floor plate summons 16 Animal 3; put party in back row and use Demon Exodus for fast clears.

Joe Bernard. method. Strongly recommended: Bring Joe to avoid most Service Robot battles, final Toronto electronics and robot bypass, Joe finale recommendation. Joe is strongly recommended: he prevents most of the Service Robot grind and handles electronics safely.
The Seed. method. Plant The Seed in the reactor, Seed reactor destination. Carry The Seed to Toronto’s reactor route and complete the final sequence.

AI Housing. method. AI Housing is not meant to be killed — let it defeat a party member to trigger ending, AI Housing Thorn Snare control, AI Housing ending trigger. AI Housing is not meant to be killed. It’s immune to weapons and most spells; Thorn Snare can hold it, but the ending triggers when a party member falls.
Gaze of Kamulos. use. Gaze of Kamulos equipment effects, Gaze of Kamulos equipment modifiers. 2H Weapon. Spell charges (6). Damage: 26.
Gaze of Kamulos. location. Gaze of Kamulos acquisition location. Kenget Kamulos
Shadowsword. use. Shadowsword equipment effects, Shadowsword equipment modifiers. Weapon. Cursed: -30 LP, -50 Stamina. Damage: 25.
Shadowsword. location. Shadowsword acquisition location. Treasure Cave (Maini)
Danu's Light. use. Danu's Light equipment effects, Danu's Light equipment modifiers. Weapon. +10 LP, +20 Speed, +5 Prot. Damage: 14.
Danu's Light. location. Danu's Light acquisition location. Beloveno weapon shop
Iskai Lance. use. Iskai Lance equipment effects, Iskai Lance equipment modifiers. 2H Weapon. -6 CLO (Drirr only). Damage: 18.
Iskai Lance. location. Iskai Lance acquisition location. Snird's Armoury
Bolt-Rifle. use. Bolt-Rifle equipment effects, Bolt-Rifle equipment modifiers. Ranged. +20 LON, uses Bolts. Damage: 18.
Bolt-Rifle. location. Bolt-Rifle acquisition location. Umajo weapon guild
Pistol. use. Pistol equipment effects, Pistol equipment modifiers. Ranged. +60 LON, uses Canisters. Damage: 30.
Pistol. location. Pistol acquisition location. Toronto COM room
Dreamshield. use. Dreamshield equipment effects, Dreamshield equipment modifiers. Shield. 12 Prot, Sleep Spores (20).
Dreamshield. location. Dreamshield acquisition location. Rifrako's (Aballon)
Serpent Staff. use. Serpent Staff equipment effects, Serpent Staff equipment modifiers. Shield. 10 Prot, +10 LP, +25 SP.
Serpent Staff. location. Serpent Staff acquisition location. Equipment Makers
Lugh's Hand Helmet. use. Lugh's Hand Helmet equipment effects, Lugh's Hand Helmet equipment modifiers. Helmet. 20 Prot, +35 Luck.
Lugh's Hand Helmet. location. Lugh's Hand Helmet acquisition location. Kenget Kamulos
Power Amulet. use. Power Amulet equipment effects, Power Amulet equipment modifiers. Accessory. +25 LP, +50 Str.
Power Amulet. location. Power Amulet acquisition location. Arjano / Kounos
Thief's Amulet. use. Thief's Amulet equipment effects, Thief's Amulet equipment modifiers. Accessory. +30 Dex, +30 Lockpick.
Thief's Amulet. location. Thief's Amulet acquisition location. Kenget Kamulos
Tom Driscoll. party. . Main protagonist. Permanent party member.
Rainer Hofstedt. party. . Government scientist. Weak combatant. Leaves mid-game.
Drirr. party. . Iskai warrior with exceptional combat abilities.
Sira. party. . Iskai mage specializing in frost and snare magic. Always leaves with Melthas.
Melthas. party. . Druid who can communicate through Iskai trii. Demon-banishing specialist.
Siobhan. party. . The most powerful warrior in the game. Natural +4 base damage.
Khunag. party. . Renegade mage seeking revenge on his order. REQUIRED for Kenget Kamulos.
Harriet. party. . Required for teleportation between islands.
Joe Bernard. party. . Technician who makes the final Toronto section much easier.
Drirr. combat. . Strengths: Best fighter early game; 99 combat caps; Tail weapon slot; High speed; Night vision. Limits: Lower max strength; Cannot use human armor; No magic.
Sira. combat. . Strengths: Powerful crowd control; Frost/Snare immobilizes enemies; High speed. Limits: Light armor only; Spells require Trifalai Seeds; Linked to Melthas.
Siobhan. combat. . Strengths: Highest damage potential; 99 combat caps; Can wield heavy 2H weapons effectively. Limits: Limited magic potential; Initially exclusive choice with Khunag.

Khunag. combat. Khunag dismissal after his chapter, Khunag permanently dismissed. Strengths: Highest magic talent (99); Powerful offensive spells; Steal Magic sustains SP. Limits: Weak in physical combat; Leaves permanently if dismissed after his chapter.

Sira spell training. training. Sira spells, Iskai (Dji-Kas). Iskai (Dji-Kas): practitioner Sira; reagent Trifalai Seed (1.2G each); training: Fasiir in Dji-Kas guild (Jirinaar). Visit Fasiir before leaving Jirinaar; this is the documented free spell-training stop for Sira.
Frost Avalanche. use. . Freezes all enemies. Cost: 30 SP. Reagent: Trifalai Seed (1.2G each).
Thorn Snare. use. . Immobilizes target completely. Cost: 16 SP. Reagent: Trifalai Seed (1.2G each).
Fungification. use. . Damage, can disintegrate weakened enemies. Cost: 24 SP. Reagent: Trifalai Seed (1.2G each).

Melthas spell scrolls. training. Melthas spells, Celtic/Mahinos (Druid). Celtic/Mahinos (Druid): practitioner Melthas; reagent None; training: Buy scrolls from Roves in Arjano library. Arjano's library is the route stop for Melthas's spell scrolls.
Demon Exodus. use. . Destroys ALL demon-type enemies. Cost: 70 SP. Reagent: None.
Magic Shield. use. . Increases M-R and Protection. Cost: 25 SP. Reagent: None.
Berserk. use. . Trade 20% LP for combat stat boost. Cost: 12 SP. Reagent: None.

Khunag spell scrolls. training. Khunag spells. Kenget Kamulos: practitioner Khunag; reagent None; training: Pickup scrolls in Kenget Kamulos dungeon. Bring Khunag: the walkthrough identifies him as required for the Kenget Kamulos route.
Thunderstorm. use. . Damage all enemies. Cost: 35 SP. Reagent: None.
Steal Magic. use. . Drain SP from enemy - sustain casting. Cost: 15 SP. Reagent: None.
Steal Life. use. . Drain LP from enemy. Cost: 15 SP. Reagent: None.

Harriet spell training. training. Harriet spells, Dji-Cantos (Enlightened Ones). Dji-Cantos (Enlightened Ones): practitioner Harriet; reagent None; training: Drannagh in Dji-Cantos building. Drannagh teaches Harriet without a spell-training fee at the Dji-Cantos building.
Goddess's Wrath. use. . Destroys enemies (proficiency = count). Cost: 160 SP. Reagent: None.
Lifebringer. use. . Heals entire party. Cost: 60 SP. Reagent: None.
Recuperation. use. . Rest without sleeping or food. Cost: 10 SP. Reagent: None.
Animal 3 (Demon). combat. Animal 3 danger and critical hits. Fast and critical-hit capable
Animal 3 (Demon). combat. . Use control or demon-banishing magic early.
Krondir. combat. . An early source of sellable Meat and Trii.
Service Robot. combat. Service Robot tactics, Service Robot encounter bypass, Joe final Toronto robot tactics. Bring Joe on the final Toronto return to bypass repair-gated robot encounters.
AI Housing. combat. . Thorn Snare can hold it; follow the walkthrough's ending trigger rather than treating it as a normal damage race.
Kamulos. combat. . Thorn Snare is the documented control tactic, followed by physical and non-Frost attacks.
Rabir (Jirinaar). trade. Rabir. Rabir (Jirinaar): Sell 110%, Buy 132%. Best documented early buyer.
Winion (Vanello). trade. Winion. Winion (Vanello): Sell 125%, Buy 150%. Best documented Gratogel rate.
Umajo shops. trade. Umajo shops. Umajo shops: Sell 130%, Buy 156%. Highest documented sell rate.
Kounos trader. trade. Kounos trader. Kounos trader: Sell 38%, Buy —. Poor place to sell.
Riolea (Beloveno). trade. Riolea. Riolea (Beloveno): Sell 75%, Buy 100%. Below the better regional buyers.

Rejira’s healing potions. trade. Rejira repeated potion conversations, Rejira Dji-Kas Guild potion method. Ending conversations with Rejira in the Dji-Kas Guild can repeatedly produce Blue Healing Potions. The public walkthrough recommends Rabir early and Umajo later as buyers.

Hold valuable loot for Umajo. trade. Umajo buyers and sell multipliers, highest Umajo sell rates. Jeros, Zeibe, and Mykonou are listed at a 130% sell multiplier, the highest rate in the published shop table.

Krondir parts fund the early route. trade. Krondir drop buyers, Krondir loot selling, Krondir parts selling destination. Krondirs drop Meat and Trii; the walkthrough lists Rabir as the useful early buyer for those drops.
The impossible planet. movement. Act I, Act 1. Escape Toronto, survive the crash, and earn a place among the Iskai.
Old powers, divided peoples. movement. Act II, Act 2. Cross Gratogel and Maini while the expedition’s true stakes begin to surface.
The truth beneath the survey. movement. Act III, Act 3, Dji-Cantos movement, Dji-Cantos campaign movement. Reach Dji-Cantos, Umajo, and the Toronto reactor trail.
High Knowledge and the Seed. movement. Act IV, Act 4. Take Khunag to Kenget Kamulos, recover Metal Magic, and return to Toronto.
Aballon. location. . Aballon (Village) on Gratogel (Celtic Island). Points of interest: Rifrako (Monster Eye, Dream Shield).
Kounos. location. . Kounos (Dungeon Village) on Maini (Human/Iskai Island). Points of interest: Melthas's friend.
Srimalinar. location. . Srimalinar (Town) on Maini (Human/Iskai Island). Points of interest: Edjiir (information broker).
Treasure Cave. location. . Treasure Cave (Dungeon) on Maini (Human/Iskai Island). Points of interest: Shadowsword; Below Kounos cliffs.
Arjano. location. . Arjano (Druid Complex) on Gratogel (Celtic Island). Points of interest: Library; Forbidden Area.
Crystal Throwing Axe. acquisition. Music Crystal. Trade Music Crystal for Crystal Throwing Axe.
Rainer Hofstedt. location. Rainer Hofstedt recruitment location. Recruitment location: Toronto, beginning. This does not establish current party membership.
Drirr. location. Drirr recruitment location. Recruitment location: Jirinaar, after festival murder. This does not establish current party membership.
Sira. location. Sira recruitment location. Recruitment location: Jirinaar, after confronting Bradir. This does not establish current party membership.
Melthas. location. Melthas recruitment location. Recruitment location: Gratogel, Druid's hut. This does not establish current party membership.
Siobhan. location. Siobhan recruitment location. Recruitment location: Beloveno, her house. This does not establish current party membership.
Khunag. location. Khunag recruitment location. Recruitment location: Beloveno, Kariah's house. This does not establish current party membership.
Harriet. location. Harriet recruitment location. Recruitment location: Dji-Cantos, replaces Rainer. This does not establish current party membership.
Joe Bernard. location. Joe Bernard recruitment location. Recruitment location: Dji-Cantos, late game (optional). This does not establish current party membership.

Frost Avalanche. acquisition. Frost Avalanche learning, Frost Avalanche spell training. Learn Frost Avalanche in Iskai (Dji-Kas) magic (practitioner Sira). Spell level 9. Cost: 30 SP. Training: Fasiir in Dji-Kas guild (Jirinaar). Visit Fasiir before leaving Jirinaar; this is the documented free spell-training stop for Sira.

Thorn Snare. acquisition. Thorn Snare learning, Thorn Snare spell training. Learn Thorn Snare in Iskai (Dji-Kas) magic (practitioner Sira). Spell level 12. Cost: 16 SP. Training: Fasiir in Dji-Kas guild (Jirinaar). Visit Fasiir before leaving Jirinaar; this is the documented free spell-training stop for Sira.

Fungification. acquisition. Fungification learning, Fungification spell training. Learn Fungification in Iskai (Dji-Kas) magic (practitioner Sira). Spell level 15. Cost: 24 SP. Training: Fasiir in Dji-Kas guild (Jirinaar). Visit Fasiir before leaving Jirinaar; this is the documented free spell-training stop for Sira.

Demon Exodus. acquisition. Demon Exodus learning, Demon Exodus spell training. Learn Demon Exodus in Celtic/Mahinos (Druid) magic (practitioner Melthas). Spell level 20. Cost: 70 SP. Training: Buy scrolls from Roves in Arjano library. Arjano's library is the route stop for Melthas's spell scrolls.

Magic Shield. acquisition. Magic Shield learning, Magic Shield spell training. Learn Magic Shield in Celtic/Mahinos (Druid) magic (practitioner Melthas). Spell level 8. Cost: 25 SP. Training: Buy scrolls from Roves in Arjano library. Arjano's library is the route stop for Melthas's spell scrolls.

Berserk. acquisition. Berserk learning, Berserk spell training. Learn Berserk in Celtic/Mahinos (Druid) magic (practitioner Melthas). Spell level 7. Cost: 12 SP. Training: Buy scrolls from Roves in Arjano library. Arjano's library is the route stop for Melthas's spell scrolls.

Thunderstorm. acquisition. Thunderstorm learning, Thunderstorm spell training. Learn Thunderstorm in Kenget Kamulos magic (practitioner Khunag). Cost: 35 SP. Training: Pickup scrolls in Kenget Kamulos dungeon. Bring Khunag: the walkthrough identifies him as required for the Kenget Kamulos route.

Steal Magic. acquisition. Steal Magic learning, Steal Magic spell training. Learn Steal Magic in Kenget Kamulos magic (practitioner Khunag). Cost: 15 SP. Training: Pickup scrolls in Kenget Kamulos dungeon. Bring Khunag: the walkthrough identifies him as required for the Kenget Kamulos route.

Steal Life. acquisition. Steal Life learning, Steal Life spell training. Learn Steal Life in Kenget Kamulos magic (practitioner Khunag). Cost: 15 SP. Training: Pickup scrolls in Kenget Kamulos dungeon. Bring Khunag: the walkthrough identifies him as required for the Kenget Kamulos route.

Goddess's Wrath. acquisition. Goddess's Wrath learning, Goddess's Wrath spell training. Learn Goddess's Wrath in Dji-Cantos (Enlightened Ones) magic (practitioner Harriet). Spell level 22. Cost: 160 SP. Training: Drannagh in Dji-Cantos building. Drannagh teaches Harriet without a spell-training fee at the Dji-Cantos building.

Lifebringer. acquisition. Lifebringer learning, Lifebringer spell training. Learn Lifebringer in Dji-Cantos (Enlightened Ones) magic (practitioner Harriet). Spell level 13. Cost: 60 SP. Training: Drannagh in Dji-Cantos building. Drannagh teaches Harriet without a spell-training fee at the Dji-Cantos building.

Recuperation. acquisition. Recuperation learning, Recuperation spell training. Learn Recuperation in Dji-Cantos (Enlightened Ones) magic (practitioner Harriet). Spell level 4. Cost: 10 SP. Training: Drannagh in Dji-Cantos building. Drannagh teaches Harriet without a spell-training fee at the Dji-Cantos building.
Equipment Makers Cellar. location. . Equipment Makers Cellar (Dungeon) on Umajo Desert. Points of interest: Serpent Staff; Metalmagic Scroll.
Merdger. location. Merger location. Merdger appears on: Device Maker Guild (wanders nearby).
Herras. location. . Herras appears on: Beloveno Town Hall (wanders nearby).
